markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (69%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Benign · Careful review
Three-class conformal set on a degraded simulated frozen section with all nearest neighbors Normal.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 69%, Benign 20%, Normal 9%, Invasive 2% [F1] | Favors InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu (alpha 0.1) | Cannot separate non-invasive classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 93% reliability, 100% OOD, JPEG-3 [F6] | Unflagged quality; extreme OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Backbones agree with each other |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match (5 Normal, 69%–74% sim) [F5] | Neighbors contradict InSitu call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 6, 7) · context · High score (+1.37), lowers invasive read (-0.75) [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Low score (+0.20), lowers invasive read (-0.38) [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.34), lowers invasive read (-0.34) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.11), nudges toward invasive (+0.29) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions beats random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064); uses Unreliable Frequent mitotic figures (0/20 spot-check).

## Could be wrong if
- Normal (9%) or Benign (20%) tissue mimics InSitu on this degraded simulated frozen section.
- Atypia is absent or invasion is missed without deeper levels (frozen-section reliability AUROC 0.70).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 9, 7**: Highest risk (55%, 38%, 28%); check for in situ versus benign tissue.
2. **Region 1**: Inspect duct-confined atypia and flagged superior margin (100% score, 108 um) [F7].
3. **Regions 6, 7**: Verify TILs versus stroma; consider drafted deeper levels order (stains blocked).
